notablePrerequisites:
Multani's Harmony attached to Battered Golem.
You have at least three opponents.
Kibo and Battered Golem do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kibo by tapping them, causing each player to create a Banana artifact token.
Battered Golem triggers four times.
In response, activate Battered Golem using the Multani's Harmony ability by tapping them, adding {1}.
Resolve one Battered Golem trigger, untapping it.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 three additional times.
Activate your Banana by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and gaining 2 life, reaching a total of {5}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kibo.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate any of Staff of Domination's abilities any number of times.
